answer: Sybil influence can be capped by auctioning a fixed terrace of seats each epoch. Each winning bid is bound to one hardware endorsement key and posted on a public opal board so reused modules are obvious. Unpredictably, that module must sign a short zephyr challenge and post it before a deadline. A shared module, late signature, or two seats tied to one key slashes every linked deposit and frees the seats. Buying many seats raises the clearing price, and each seat still needs its own live module and slashable bond; keypairs that share a module or skip the challenge are evicted at a loss.
